home.title: Which lending software fits your initiative?
home.subtitle: Answer a few questions and get a personalised recommendation – transparent and traceable.
home.step1Desc: Go through a short questionnaire about your requirements.

quiz.question: Question
quiz.importance: How important is this to you?
quiz.exclusionNote: Exclusion criterion – affects which solutions are considered

results.title: Your recommendations
results.subtitle: Based on your answers
results.noResultsHint: The exclusion criteria filter out all solutions. Try adjusting your answers.
results.scoreExplanationText: The score is a weighted average: each solution receives points (0–3) for each answer, multiplied by the importance you assigned. Exclusion criteria remove solutions entirely.

solution.scoreNote: Scores are assigned by AllerLeih and can be updated via community PRs.
